findings.claim: PRIOR MAJOR RESOLVED. The Q1 WHY-NOT-C rationale no longer labels C 'quantifier_upgrade', no longer offers 'Nobody can notch the Halberd now' as proof that the shape's benefit recurs in cost, and no longer contradicts Q4. The repair is the only substantive edit in the unit and it lands exactly on the defect.
findings.evidence: candidates-corrected -> candidates-final diff: q1.rationale is the only field with a substantive rewrite (q2/q3/q4/q5 changes are cosmetic: 'demanded by law 10' dropped, 'quantifier_downgrade with a scope flaw' -> 'reversed sub-claim wrapped in a quantifier_downgrade', 'forty-floor' -> 'forty-story' aligning the Q4 quote with the passage's 'forty-story block', and two quote-terminal periods moved outside the quote marks); passage, prompts, options, keys and generator_meta are byte-identical. New Q1 WHY-NOT-C: "(trap: role_or_attribution_swap / detail-as-main - a true supporting point carried into a verdict the text withholds): both factual halves of C are accurate ... The passage really does say a shaped tower's advantage runs 'for as long as the building stands, unattended and unbilled', so 'never has to be paid for again' is fair reporting rather than an upgrade - Q4's rationale grants the same point from the other side ('Cost is not what separates them; recoverability is'). ... First the ranking: 'the better technique' is exactly the judgment the text declines to make - 'Neither is obviously the safer bet', and 'Rask will not tell an owner which to build.' Second the attribution ... Third the scope ... ('Nobody can notch the Halberd now')". The Halberd sentence is now used for the recoverability/scope point, i.e. the same use Q4 makes of it. Independent re-verification: all 47 single-quoted spans across the five rationales match the passage/stems/options verbatim modulo conventional adaptation, with only four non-passage spans, all legitimate (the explicit Q4-rationale cross-quote 'Cost is not what separates them; recoverability is'; the two heuristic labels 'pick the qualified answer' and 'pick the cautious option'; and the bracket-restored Q5 close 'cannot be [restored]'). Keys B,A,D,C,A - no letter column, no positional tell. Option lengths 16-23 words; key is uniquely longest in 2 of 5 (Q1, Q4), not longest in Q3. Passage 785 words, inside the 550-825 ELF long_passage band. AmE variety internally consistent (percent, modeling, meters, forty-story, neighbor); zero BrE tokens. Both glossary lines complete. No PUA characters. Post-repair gates all pass: 10 G-KEY records (votes 1 and 2, both regated), solver answers B/A/D/C/A = keys, 0 kills, 0 flags; 10 G-DISTRACTOR records, all pass.
findings.why: The refutation-grade defect from round 1 is genuinely gone rather than papered over, and nothing in the rewrite broke a quote, a key, a band or a gate. Recorded as info so the resolution is auditable, not as a defect.

findings.claim: PERSISTS FROM ROUND 1 (unfixed). The Q2 'hedge inversion' note still tells the student that 'pick the qualified answer' does not work across this unit, when on the unit's actual option set that heuristic picks the key outright in Q1, Q3 and Q4 and narrows Q5 to two - it fails only in Q2, the one item the note is attached to.
findings.evidence: Current Q2 rationale: "Note the deliberate hedge inversion: here the key is the confident, near-absolute claim and the cautious-sounding option is the wrong one, so 'pick the qualified answer' does not work across this unit." The pedagogy stage touched this exact sentence in the repair pass (candidates-corrected 'hedge inversion demanded by law 10' -> candidates-final 'hedge inversion') and left the generalisation standing. Against it: Q1 key B is the only comparative/hedged option ('differ less in what they deliver at handover than in what becomes of it later') among three assertive rivals; Q3 key D carries no quantifier while its rivals read 'every damper' and 'Each of the nineteen ... a full seven percent'; Q4 key C is the sole option with an explicit hedge ('settled partly by') against 'it is really only the cost' and 'should only be built'; Q5 key A is the concessive-plus-qualification form. report.json's own G-STEM notes concur: 'That leaves the hedged comparative B' (q:1), 'C is D's absolute twin (each of the nineteen, a full seven percent)' (q:3), 'A is the only concessive-plus-qualification shape, which is the usual key form for this stem type' (q:5). GENERATION.md law 10 requires breaking the hedge/key correlation 'across the unit'; one inverted item in five is the floor of that requirement, not a unit-wide break.
findings.why: Under the charitable reading ('the heuristic is not reliable unit-wide') the sentence is true, which keeps it minor rather than major; under the plain reading a student is told a shortcut is dead when it in fact wins 3 of 5 items here and shortlists a 4th. No key, option or passage text is affected, and law 10 is a judgment call the pedagogy stage owns rather than a mechanical gate. Re-raised because a round-1 finding survived a pass that edited the very sentence.

findings.claim: PERSISTS FROM ROUND 1 (unfixed). 'mechanical rooms take on water' still reads on first pass as flooding or a leak rather than as the intended acquisition of standing water mass.
findings.evidence: Passage, unchanged in the repair: 'Fit-out adds partitions, tenants add paper and machinery, mechanical rooms take on water, and every addition of mass drags the frequency down.' Idiomatically 'take on water' is a vessel springing a leak; the sense required is 'come to hold water' (tanks, sprinkler risers, cooling plant). The phrase is also reprinted inside the Q3 WHY-KEY quote, so the wording reaches the student twice.
findings.why: The trailing clause 'every addition of mass' disambiguates for a careful reader, and no question or key depends on the phrase, so the CORRECTED language verdict is not overturned. It stays a survivor rather than an out-of-scope nit because the same stage resolved neighbouring items in this passage ('laid steel plate' -> 'layered steel plate', 'two fifths' -> 'two-fifths', 'forty-floor' -> 'forty-story', and the truncated glossary line 'the building's own' -> 'the building's own sway').

findings.claim: The unit ships with four G-STEM 'major' flags never dispositioned by any downstream stage, one of which (q:3) is not a mere narrowing but a blind route to the key: report.json records 'WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind pick D)'. No review record in reviews/*.jsonl acknowledges or adjudicates them.
findings.evidence: report.json['elf-b10-001'] = status SURVIVED_FLAGGED with flags on q:1, q:3, q:4, q:5, all severity 'major'. q:3 note: 'WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind pick D): adding mass lowers a structure's natural frequency, so D is reachable from first-year structural dynamics, and C is D's absolute twin (each of the nineteen, a full seven percent).' q:1/q:4/q:5 notes all read 'PARTIALLY' (field narrowed to two). Against that, reviews/final_verify.jsonl last record for this candidate is the round-1 REFUTED fold whose note counts only 'gkey_records=10 gkey_kills=0 gkey_flags=0 gdistr_kills=0 gdistr_flags=0' - G-STEM is not in the fold's tally at all, and verdicts-vfinal/verdicts-gstem.jsonl contains no elf-b10-001 record (6 lines, all las-b10-001). The two review notes that do exist (pedagogy.jsonl line 7, integrated.jsonl line 8) address only the Q1 WHY-NOT-C rewrite.
findings.why: Informational rather than refutation-grade: G-STEM flags are non-killing under the certified gate stack, 'PARTIALLY' narrowing to two survivors is normal for authentic HP long-passage items, and Q3's world-knowledge route still leaves A and B as substantive positions. But q:3 is the one item where a test-wise student with first-year physics can reach the key without the passage, and it compounds with the hedge-correlation finding above (on Q3 the qualified-answer heuristic and the physics heuristic both select D). The gap worth recording is procedural: the vfinal fold re-ran G-KEY and G-DISTRACTOR against the repaired unit but not G-STEM, so these flags carried over from the pre-repair report without re-adjudication.

findings.claim: Two clauses in the rewritten Q1 WHY-NOT-C are looser than the argument they carry: 'both factual halves of C are accurate' is only coherent if 'halves' means the two sub-claims of C's since-clause, since C's first half is the evaluative ranking the same paragraph goes on to reject; and Q4's rationale does not 'grant the same point from the other side' - it is silent on whether the shape's benefit recurs and says only that cost is not the decisive difference.
findings.evidence: Q1 option C: 'That shaping a tower is the better technique, since its benefit, unlike a damper's, never has to be paid for again.' Q1 rationale: 'both factual halves of C are accurate, which is what keeps it live ... - Q4's rationale grants the same point from the other side (\'Cost is not what separates them; recoverability is\'). The flaw is what C does with that true detail. First the ranking: \'the better technique\' is exactly the judgment the text declines to make'. Q4 WHY-NOT-B in full: 'the passage insists on the asymmetry - a damper can be retuned and the benefit \'came back almost in full\', whereas \'Nobody can notch the Halberd now\'. Cost is not what separates them; recoverability is.' Q4's sentence is a rejection of option B's 'it is really only the cost of that work that separates them', i.e. a denial of cost-as-the-decisive-difference, not an endorsement of C's cost claim.
findings.why: No contradiction survives - on the contextual reading the two rationales are consistent (the cost difference is real but not decisive; recoverability is the axis), and the singular 'that true detail' two sentences later confirms the intended parse of 'both factual halves'. Flagged only because a fast reader can take away 'the ranking is accurate, the text merely declines to state it', when the text actively refuses it ('Neither is obviously the safer bet'). A three-word tightening ('both factual claims in C's since-clause are accurate' / 'Q4's rationale looks at the same asymmetry from the other side') would close it. Explicitly not a re-raise of the round-1 major, which is resolved.

findings.claim: The repair introduces in-unit trap duplication: Q1 WHY-NOT-C is now labelled 'role_or_attribution_swap', the same label and the same underlying misconception as Q5 WHY-NOT-C, and 'detail-as-main' is now carried by both Q1 WHY-NOT-A and Q1 WHY-NOT-C.
findings.evidence: Q1 WHY-NOT-A: '(trap: scope_error / detail-as-main, distorted)'. Q1 WHY-NOT-C (new): '(trap: role_or_attribution_swap / detail-as-main ...)' with 'that ranking is Marek's ... so C offers one advocate's conclusion as the writer's thesis'. Q5 WHY-NOT-C: '(trap: role_or_attribution_swap - the TYPE-005 signature): this is Marek's quoted position - \'A shape is a decision made once\' - offered as the writer's.' Before the repair Q1 C was labelled 'quantifier_upgrade of a half-truth', so the duplication is a side effect of the fix.
findings.why: Harmless in itself - a main-idea item and a stance item may legitimately share the advocate-versus-author theme, and Q1 C's rationale also names two flaws Q5 C does not (the unranked comparative, the one-arm scope) - but it thins the unit's trap variety and makes the WHY-NOT-A / WHY-NOT-C contrast within Q1 less crisp. Cosmetic; no key, option or gate is affected.

findings.claim: The rewritten Q1 rationale now supplies enough to answer Q5 without rereading the passage, which the pre-repair version did not.
findings.evidence: New Q1 WHY-NOT-C text states, in one paragraph, that 'the better technique' is 'exactly the judgment the text declines to make - \'Neither is obviously the safer bet\', and \'Rask will not tell an owner which to build\'', that 'that ranking is Marek's, put \'without qualification\' and answered on the spot by Rask', and that 'C offers one advocate's conclusion as the writer's thesis'. Q5 asks 'What is the writer's attitude to Marek's case against machinery?' with key A ('He grants Marek that a shape outlasts its owners, while denying that this is what makes it the safer choice') against C ('He shares Marek's view ...'), B (record bears Marek out) and D (vanity, entirely discredited). Those three sentences eliminate C, B and D and select A. The pre-repair Q1 rationale mentioned neither Marek's attribution nor 'Rask will not tell an owner which to build'.
findings.why: Only bites in the sequential drill flow, where Q1's rationale is revealed before Q5 is attempted; in a whole-block presentation the rationales are read after the fact and nothing leaks. The material is the passage's own, freely available to the student anyway, and Q5's own rationale quotes the same lines. Recorded so that a future rationale-scoped leak check has the case on file, not as a reason to withhold the unit.
